newsitem.title: USA: ImmuCell to start DiffGAM diarrhea trial.
newsitem.headline: ImmuCell to start DiffGAM diarrhea trial.

text.p: ImmuCell Corp said Thursday it is preparing to conduct a clinical trial of its product, DiffGAM for diarrhea.
DiffGAM is intended to prevent or treat Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea.
Clostridium difficile is a bacterium that often flourishes in the colons of patients receiving broad spectrum antibiotic therapy.
The objectives of this human clinical trial are to investigate the safety of DiffGAM and the bioavailability of the product using ImmuCell's proprietary colonic delivery system.
Trial results are expected by the second quarter of 1997.
